analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 215,500) vs SMA5 (KRW 228,000)/SMA20 (KRW 257,850)/SMA50 (KRW 256,840): Below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 278,082)/SMA200 (KRW 231,815): Weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (43.2%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.5→31.3): Entered oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-396.0553→-6809.0850): Worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 216,723): Approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 189,200): Close to Pivot S1 (KRW 184,833), a key support zone.
· Swing resistance (KRW 223,000): First resistance level on a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day high lower than 20-day high signals weakness, 5-day and 20-day lows are identical indicating a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.80x): Subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Low confidence in bounces due to directionless ADX and subdued volume, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
